newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline holds around earlier lower levels.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline holds around earlier lower levels.

text.p: NWE gasoline held around the lower levels established earlier in the day but trade was light with some players away from their desks until after the holidays, traders said.

Eurograde barges saw some action with a barge moving $3 below the level traded earlier on Monday. The same seller sold earlier at $224 and later at $221 a tonne fob ARA for prompt material. Brokers assessed Jan 1-15 levels around $219 fob ARA.
January swaps were lightly traded with three deals heard done between $214 and $214.50 a tonne.
Cargo levels were difficult to pin down. Brokers said there was no firm talk and assessed the market some $2-3 a tonne below Friday's quoted levels.
